high_level_description: The image shows a display of colorful tiles on a shelf. The tiles are rectangular and feature a vibrant design with a large yellow flower at the center, surrounded by smaller pink and purple petals. The background of the tiles is blue, and there are green leaves and small yellow accents extending from the central flower. The tiles are neatly arranged in rows, with some stacked to the right side of the frame. The setting appears to be indoors, possibly in a shop or a craft store, as suggested by the wooden shelving and the organized arrangement of the items.
